annotations.title: Convert currency at ECB reference rates

description: Convert an amount between two of the ~30 currencies published by the European Central Bank (including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, BRL, MXN), today or on a past date since 1999. Returns rate, converted amount and observation date. For CLP, ARS, COP or PEN use latam_fx or the country tools. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /fx/convert via x402.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest rate.
